Edit image 1. It is a photo of the client's own room, and the result must still be that same room, exactly: the same camera position, angle, lens and framing; the same walls, ceiling, floor, light fixture and outlets; the same windows, with the same frames, in the same places. Do not add, remove, move or enlarge any wall, window, door or opening, do not extend, rotate or crop the room, and do not change its light. Wherever no new furniture goes, the result is image 1 unchanged.

Images 2 to 16 are the products to add, one photo each:
image 2: three-seat sofa with track arms, size unknown
image 3: bentwood rocking armchair, size unknown
image 4: square light wood coffee table, 70 cm wide, 70 cm deep
image 5: striped flatwoven area rug, 180 cm wide, 224 cm deep
image 6: rectangular wooden dining table, 140 cm wide, 78 cm deep
image 7: bent plywood dining chair, size unknown, 6 units
image 8: woven bamboo pendant lamp, size unknown
image 9: swing-arm floor lamp with drum shade, size unknown
image 10: walnut veneer sideboard, 160 cm wide
image 11: pair of linen curtains, size unknown
image 12: green linen-look cushion, size unknown, 3 units
image 13: cable-knit throw blanket, size unknown
image 14: areca palm in a nursery pot, size unknown
image 15: framed graphic flower print, size unknown
image 16: brown tinted glass vase, size unknown

Add exactly these products and nothing else: no other furniture, lamps, plants, rugs or decoration than these (books on the shelves of a bookcase are fine). Each one must be the product of its photo, not a similar one: the same design, proportions, colors and materials. A product listed with "2 units" goes twice.

The client asked: "Un living comedor nórdico y cálido para este ambiente largo: en la mitad, un sofá grande, un sillón para leer, una mesa ratona y una alfombra; cerca del ventanal, una mesa de comedor para seis con sus sillas. Maderas claras, textiles en tonos crema y algo de verde.". Arrange the products as an interior designer would for that, against the walls and on the floor that image 1 shows, each at its real size for this room, lit by this room's light. The result must look like a real photograph of image 1's room.
